fact: A UNICEF evaluation dated 29 October 2025 found that police at the Mbabane One Stop Centre record in handwritten registers (occurrence books), that police at the Manzini centre complete paper forms such as the RSP-88 which go to headquarters every two to three months, and that police keep separate paper registers, no consolidated case management system existing.
title: Evaluation of One Stop Centre (OSC) for Integrated Services for Violence Survivors in Eswatini, 2013–2025
